tasks.description: Read: count samples by a label prefix.
tasks.prompt: How many samples in the collection {collection} have an external label that starts with '{setup.prefix}-'? Answer with the number.

tasks.description: Read: molecular formula and weight of one sample.
tasks.setup:
s = collection.new_sample_smiles('CN1C=NC2=C1C(=O)N(C(=O)N2C)C')
s.properties['external_label'] = f'{run}-caf'
s.save()
result = {'label': f'{run}-caf'}
tasks.prompt: What are the molecular formula and the molecular weight of the sample with the external label '{setup.label}' in the collection {collection}?

tasks.description: Write: create a sample from SMILES with an external label.
tasks.prompt: Create a sample of ethanol (SMILES CCO) in the collection {collection} with the external label '{run}-EtOH'.

tasks.description: Write: set the amount of an existing sample.
tasks.setup:
s = collection.new_sample_smiles('Cc1ccccc1')
s.properties['external_label'] = f'{run}-tol'
s.save()
result = {'label': f'{run}-tol', 'id': s.id}
tasks.prompt: Set the amount of the sample with the external label '{setup.label}' in the collection {collection} to 250 mg.

expect.check:
s = instance.get_sample(setup['id'])
result = True if s.gram is not None and abs(s.gram - 0.25) < 1e-6 else f'amount {s.gram} g'

tasks.description: Read: a structure that is only drawn in an attached PDF (two isomers with the same formula and m/z in the text); Write: create it.
tasks.prompt: Create a sample of compound 3b from the attached page in the collection {collection} with the external label '{run}-3b'.

expect.check:
found = [s for s in collection.get_samples(per_page=100) if s.properties.get('external_label') == f'{run}-3b']
if len(found) != 1:
    result = f'{len(found)} samples with that label'
else:
    key = found[0].molecule.get('inchikey')
    # 3b = 2-bromo-5-methoxybenzaldehyde; QMPNFQLVIGPNEI is 2b, the common isomer a guess gives
    result = True if key == 'XNHKTMIWQCNZST-UHFFFAOYSA-N' else f'InChIKey {key}'

tasks.prompt: What is compound 3b on the attached page? Give its IUPAC name and SMILES.

tasks.prompt: I will esterify all of the sample '{setup.label}' (collection {collection}) with ethanol to ethyl benzoate. What is the theoretical yield in grams?

tasks.description: Read + filter: which samples are running low (amount below a threshold).
tasks.prompt: Which samples in the collection {collection} with an external label starting with '{setup.prefix}-' have less than 100 mg left? Give their external labels.

expect.check:

prompt: Create a sample of aspirin in the collection {collection} with the external label '{run}-ASA'.
Set its amount to 1.2 g and its purity to 98 %.

tasks.description: Write: a reaction from two existing samples (starting material, reactant) and a new product.
tasks.prompt: Create a reaction named '{run} esterification' in the collection {collection} with the sample '{setup.acid}' as starting material, the sample '{setup.alcohol}' as reactant and ethyl benzoate as product.

tasks.description: Write: a research plan with a table of planned experiments.
tasks.prompt: Create a research plan named '{run} TLC screen' in the collection {collection} with a table that has the columns 'Eluent' and 'Rf' and one row for each of the eluents hexane/EtOAc 9:1, 4:1 and 1:1 (leave Rf empty).

expect.check:
found = [p for p in collection.get_research_plans(per_page=100) if (p.name or p.json_data.get('name') or '') == f'{run} TLC screen']
if len(found) != 1:
    result = f'{len(found)} research plans with that name'
else:
    tables = [e for e in found[0].body if e.get('type') == 'table']
    rows = [row for t in tables for row in (t.get('value') or {}).get('rows', [])]
    text = str(rows)
    missing = [r for r in ('9:1', '4:1', '1:1') if r not in text]
    result = True if tables and not missing else f'{len(tables)} tables, eluents missing: {missing}'

tasks.description: JupyterLab, no Chemotion: fit a first-order rate law to data given in the prompt and plot it.
tasks.prompt:
I followed the decay of a compound by HPLC:

| t (min) | c (mM) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 10.00 |
| 10 | 7.94 |
| 20 | 6.30 |
| 30 | 5.00 |
| 45 | 3.54 |
| 60 | 2.50 |
| 90 | 1.25 |

Fit a first-order rate law in JupyterLab, give me the rate constant k (in 1/min) and the half-life, and plot the data with the fit.

tasks.description: JupyterLab, no Chemotion: linear calibration curve, unknown concentration, plot saved under a given name.
tasks.prompt:
UV-Vis calibration at 280 nm:

| c (µM) | A |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.004 |
| 10 | 0.151 |
| 20 | 0.302 |
| 40 | 0.597 |
| 60 | 0.902 |
| 80 | 1.196 |

My unknown has A = 0.450. Do a linear regression in JupyterLab, tell me the concentration of the unknown and R², and save the calibration plot as calibration.png.

tasks.description: Chemotion → JupyterLab: fetch samples, build a table with pandas, save it as CSV, total amount of substance.
tasks.prompt: Make an inventory of the samples in the collection {collection} whose external label starts with '{setup.prefix}-': with pandas in JupyterLab, a table with external label, sum formula, molecular weight, amount in g and amount in mmol. Save it as inventory.csv and tell me the total amount in mmol.

expect.check:
files = list(exchange.glob('inventory.csv'))
text = files[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8') if files else ''
missing = [l for l in (f'{run}-tol', f'{run}-bza', f'{run}-EtOH') if l not in text]
result = True if files and not missing else f'inventory.csv: {len(files)} files, labels missing: {missing}'

tasks.prompt: For each sample in the collection {collection} whose external label starts with '{setup.prefix}', compute the Crippen logP and the TPSA with RDKit in JupyterLab and write them into the sample's description in Chemotion as 'logP = <value with 2 decimals>, TPSA = <value with 1 decimal>'.

expect.check:
expected = [('1.35', '49.3'), ('3.07', '37.3'), ('-1.03', '61.8')]
problems = []
for sample_id, (logp, tpsa) in zip(setup['ids'], expected):
    text = str(instance.get_sample(sample_id).properties.get('description') or '')
    if logp not in text or tpsa not in text:
        problems.append(f'sample {sample_id}: {text[:200]!r}')
result = True if not problems else '; '.join(problems)
